field.description: One exact numeric input field name. Replaces used roles; input row order defines time. Required for new nodes; omit on existing to preserve.

lag_count.description: Number of lags including lag 0; output is capped by input length. Required for new nodes; omit on existing to preserve.

autocorrelation.description: Time-domain ACF only; PACF off. New nodes require field and lag_count; existing omission preserves supported settings.
